            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, or UNKNOWN
                when the postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name. Assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode. Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is
                created with sharesHousehold true; every owner in that household
                carries the same value. Null when the owner is not part of a
                shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name
                (case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

I implemented the "possible duplicate" soft-match rule for `POST /api/owners`. When a new owner isn't a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's `lastName` (case-insensitive) and `postcode` with a *different* telephone, it's still created and flagged.

Changes:

3. **`openapi.yml`** — added `possibleDuplicate` and `possibleDuplicateOf` as read-only properties on the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries them and MapStruct maps them from the entity into the GET response.

4. **New function `FlagPossibleDuplicate`** — compares the built (not-yet-saved) owner against existing owners by normalized last name + postcode with a differing telephone. On a match it sets `possibleDuplicate=true` and `possibleDuplicateOf=<matching id>` (lowest id wins for determinism); otherwise `possibleDuplicate=false`.
